name: blueprint/topic-radar
description: Many keyless feeds on one topic, ranked and deduped into a digest: fetch, extract mentions, dedupe by url, summarise, notify
recipe: fetch N keyless feeds -> extract topic mentions per item -> dedupe by url across feeds -> rank, summarise, store the digest, notify once
pitfalls: dedupe before summarise - cross-posted items otherwise dominate
a feed that 403s goes through the blocked-page-recovery ladder
cap the window - the rolling scan is the trend
rank by freshness and source, not just count
